purpose: Pin the immutable 24-case 2025-2026 House holdout cohort before enumerating official pre-vote House Journal pages. This step is source-only and keeps outcomes and mechanic extraction sealed.

indexPolicy.name: house-journal-current-session-enumeration-v1
indexPolicy.availabilityRule: The official current-session index and exact Journal page must agree on the Journal date, and only pages dated strictly before a frozen case vote date may match that case.
indexPolicy.notes: The frozen cohort predates Journal discovery. The current-session index is enumerated directly and exact pages are matched only by frozen bill identifiers. No bill search, outcome, mechanic presence, or source-availability replacement is allowed.
